subject: Vendor onboarding: metadata hold, tiered spend cap and SKU line correction
messages:
From: Alyssa Moon <alyssa@bluefrost.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procops@bluefrost.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding hold - missing metadata blocking PO issuance

Hi Marcus,

Quick heads-up: our onboarding pipeline flagged a metadata mismatch and Finance is holding PO issuance for BlueFrost until a few items are resolved. Details below: 

- Missing Government Tax ID (company filed as an LLP, system expects EIN)
- Bank remittance file not validated (pending the signed bank-wiring PDF)
- SKU catalogue keys sent in last spreadsheet don’t match your procurement ledger (line codes appear to be old prefixes)
- Requested initial spend cap unclear — our procurement team set a $120k annual cap, but your portal shows a $50k provisional cap for the US region

Attached: bluefrost_onboarding-form.pdf (completed), bf_bank-wiring.pdf (unsigned scan)

Can your team:
1) Confirm which spend cap tier will be applied while the vendor is in provisional state (US-only or account-wide)?
2) Share the expected PO number format (we want to map our SKU prefixes to your line-item tokens before PO is released)

We’d like to avoid a delay on the initial placement scheduled for next week.

Thanks,
Alyssa Moon
Head of Partnerships
BlueFrost AI
alyssa@bluefrost.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Procurement Ops <procops@bluefrost.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding hold - missing metadata blocking PO issuance

Alyssa — thanks for the flag and for sending the completed form. Short answers and next steps below.

Summary: 
- Spending tier: provisional onboarding defaults to the provisional-spendcap (system code PROV-50) which in your account currently maps to $50,000 for the US-only region. We can escalate to a tiered provisional policy to allow $120,000 if Procurement signs off.
- PO format: PONUM-<region>-<4digit> (e.g., PONUM-US-0421). That should be stable; I’ll ask Ops to map your SKU prefixes to the PO line tokens before issuance.
- SKU mismatch: please attach the latest SKU sheet with the vendor's internal SKU and your SKU token column. Monica — can you run a quick reconcile and create a mapping table? Jordan — once mapping is confirmed, can Finance lift the hold or provision a temporary override?

Monica: suggested action (can you confirm ETA):
- Validate tax ID (we accept EIN or foreign tax registration entry; signature on the onboarding PDF needs to match bank info)
- Reconcile sku_mapping_v2.xlsx against our procurement ledger (if there's a prefix change we need to normalize on our side)
- If vendor provides signed bank-wiring PDF and matching tax docs, mark status "Ready for PO issuance" in the onboarding tracker

Jordan: if Procurement approves the tier bump, we’ll need a short-term provisional override code to permit the initial PO. If you prefer, we can route a one-off credit/limit increase instead of changing the account-wide tier.

Alyssa — once we have the signed wiring and the SKU mapping, we should be able to issue the PO within 24 hours. Apologies for the extra friction here — happy to coordinate a quick call if it helps.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Strategic Supply
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

- Signed tax documentation (EIN or foreign equivalent) matching legal name on onboarding-form.pdf
- Signed bank-wiring confirmation (we received an unsigned scan; please apply a handwritten signature or upload a bank letter on company letterhead)
- SKU mapping: please use the attached vendor-onboard-matrix.csv and populate these columns: vendor_sku, vendor_label, your_sku_token, qty_uom. The earlier sheet used old prefixes (BF-OLD-###) which won’t reconcile to our ledger.

Process I’ll follow once docs are in: 
1) Validate tax ID and bank remittance (1 business day)
2) Run SKU normalization script against procurement ledger (PROC-ETL job, ~2 hours)
3) Create mapping file and post it to the onboarding ticket
4) If mapping requires line-item corrections, I’ll open a temporary line-remap override request to Finance (Jordan) with specific SKU examples and suggested PO line allocations

I created a Jira ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4821 — please attach the completed vendor-onboard-matrix.csv to that ticket.

Attachments: vendor-onboard-matrix.csv (text/csv)

ETA: I can run step 1+2 today if we get the signed docs by 13:00 PT. If all checks pass I will mark the vendor as "Ready for PO issuance" and Marcus can proceed to request the PO format mapping.
